slides.heading: Mini Project with Functions
slides.body: Mini Project with Functions is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Mini Project with Functions
slides.body: A mini project with functions combines several smaller tasks into one organized program. This makes the program easier to understand and improve.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A function-based project is like a school program with separate committees: each group has a role, but all contribute to the event.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Create a function that prints an item and price using an f-string.
